CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `cost_events_allocation_group_validate_insert`
BEFORE INSERT ON `cost_events`
BEGIN
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NULL AND (
		NEW.`allocation_group_id` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros` IS NOT NULL
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'non-shared cost cannot reference an allocation group') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NOT NULL AND (
		NEW.`allocation_group_id` IS NULL OR NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros` NOT IN (0, 1)
		OR NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM `cost_allocation_groups`
			WHERE `id` = NEW.`allocation_group_id`
				AND `state` = 'draft' AND `is_current` = 0
				AND `shared_object_ref` = NEW.`shared_object_ref`
				AND `allocation_version` = NEW.`allocation_version`
				AND `allocation_method` = NEW.`allocation_method`
				AND `stream` = NEW.`stream`
				AND `category` = NEW.`category`
				AND `source_total_amount_micros` = NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros`
		)
		OR NEW.`amount_micros` <> CAST((NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros` * NEW.`allocation_share_bps`) / 10000 AS INTEGER) + NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros`
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'cost allocation group mismatch') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `cost_events_shared_allocation_validate_insert`
BEFORE INSERT ON `cost_events`
BEGIN
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NULL AND (
		NEW.`allocation_method` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`allocation_version` IS NOT NULL
		OR NEW.`allocation_group_id` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`allocation_share_bps` IS NOT NULL
		OR NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros` IS NOT NULL
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'non-shared cost cannot carry allocation fields') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NOT NULL AND (
		NEW.`allocation_method` IS NULL OR NEW.`allocation_version` IS NULL
		OR NEW.`allocation_group_id` IS NULL
		OR NEW.`allocation_share_bps` IS NULL OR NEW.`allocation_share_bps` <= 0
		OR NEW.`allocation_share_bps` > 10000
		OR NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros` IS NULL OR NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros` < 0
		OR NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros` NOT IN (0, 1)
		OR NEW.`amount_micros` <> CAST((NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros` * NEW.`allocation_share_bps`) / 10000 AS INTEGER) + NEW.`allocation_remainder_micros`
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'shared allocation amount or share is invalid') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM `cost_events`
		WHERE `allocation_group_id` = NEW.`allocation_group_id`
			AND (`shared_object_ref` <> NEW.`shared_object_ref`
				OR `allocation_version` <> NEW.`allocation_version`
				OR `allocation_method` <> NEW.`allocation_method`
				OR `shared_total_amount_micros` <> NEW.`shared_total_amount_micros`)
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'shared allocation group identity mismatch') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`shared_object_ref` IS NOT NULL AND
		COALESCE((
			SELECT SUM(`allocation_share_bps`) FROM `cost_events`
			WHERE `allocation_group_id` = NEW.`allocation_group_id`
		), 0) + NEW.`allocation_share_bps` > 10000
		THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'shared allocation exceeds source total') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `external_action_approvals_insert_gate`
BEFORE INSERT ON `external_action_approvals`
WHEN NEW.`action` NOT IN ('approve_application_package','submit_application')
  OR NEW.`state` NOT IN ('requested','approved','revoked','completed')
  OR NEW.`state` = 'completed'
  OR (
    NEW.`state` = 'requested'
    AND (NEW.`approved_at` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`revoked_at` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL)
  )
  OR (
    NEW.`state` = 'approved'
    AND (NEW.`approved_at` IS NULL OR NEW.`revoked_at` IS NOT NULL OR NEW.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL)
  )
  OR (
    NEW.`state` = 'revoked'
    AND (
      NEW.`revoked_at` IS NULL
      OR NEW.`completed_at` IS NOT NULL
      OR (NEW.`approved_at` IS NOT NULL AND NEW.`revoked_at` < NEW.`approved_at`)
    )
  )
  OR (
    NEW.`state` = 'approved'
    AND (
      NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM `pursuit_packages` p
         WHERE p.`id` = NEW.`pursuit_package_id`
           AND p.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
           AND p.`payload_sha256` = NEW.`payload_sha256`
           AND p.`readiness_state` = 'ready_for_review'
           AND p.`blockers_json` = '[]'
           AND json_valid(p.`answers_json`)
           AND json_type(p.`answers_json`, '$.questionSetChecksum') = 'text'
           AND length(trim(json_extract(p.`answers_json`, '$.questionSetChecksum'))) = 64
           AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM `job_posting_versions` bound_version
              WHERE bound_version.`id` = p.`job_posting_version_id`
                AND bound_version.`capture_state` = 'verified'
                AND json_valid(bound_version.`source_facts_json`)
                AND json_type(bound_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.questionSetChecksum') = 'text'
                AND json_extract(bound_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.questionSetChecksum') =
                    json_extract(p.`answers_json`, '$.questionSetChecksum')
                AND p.`destination_url` = COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(json_extract(bound_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.applyUrl'), ''),
                    NULLIF(json_extract(bound_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.canonicalUrl'), ''),
                    (SELECT posting.`canonical_url` FROM `job_postings` posting WHERE posting.`id` = bound_version.`job_posting_id`)
                )
           )
           AND json_valid(p.`asset_manifest_json`)
           AND json_type(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') = 'array'
           AND json_array_length(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') BETWEEN 1 AND 2
           AND p.`job_posting_version_id` = (
             SELECT current_version.`id`
               FROM `job_posting_versions` current_version
               JOIN `pursuits` pursuit
                 ON pursuit.`id` = p.`pursuit_id`
                AND pursuit.`user_id` = p.`user_id`
               JOIN `job_postings` current_posting
                 ON current_posting.`id` = pursuit.`job_posting_id`
                AND current_posting.`description_checksum` = current_version.`description_checksum`
              WHERE current_version.`job_posting_id` = pursuit.`job_posting_id`
              LIMIT 1
           )
           AND (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') m WHERE json_extract(m.`value`, '$.type') = 'resume') = 1
           AND (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') m WHERE json_extract(m.`value`, '$.type') = 'cover_letter') <= 1
           AND (
             (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') m WHERE json_extract(m.`value`, '$.type') = 'cover_letter') = 0
             OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM `job_posting_versions` cover_version,
                      json_each(cover_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.questionSet') question
                WHERE cover_version.`id` = p.`job_posting_version_id`
                  AND lower(json_extract(question.`value`, '$.label')) LIKE '%cover letter%'
             )
           )
           AND (
             NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
                 FROM `job_posting_versions` required_cover_version,
                      json_each(required_cover_version.`source_facts_json`, '$.questionSet') question
                WHERE required_cover_version.`id` = p.`job_posting_version_id`
                  AND lower(json_extract(question.`value`, '$.label')) LIKE '%cover letter%'
                  AND json_extract(question.`value`, '$.required') = 1
             )
             OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') m WHERE json_extract(m.`value`, '$.type') = 'cover_letter') = 1
           )
           AND (
             NEW.`action` <> 'approve_application_package'
             OR (
               NEW.`approved_pursuit_revision` IS NOT NULL
               AND NEW.`attestation_version` = 'application-package-staging-v1'
               AND NEW.`attestation_sha256` IS NOT NULL
               AND length(NEW.`attestation_sha256`) = 64
               AND EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM `pursuits` current_pursuit
                  WHERE current_pursuit.`id` = p.`pursuit_id`
                    AND current_pursuit.`user_id` = p.`user_id`
                    AND current_pursuit.`revision` = NEW.`approved_pursuit_revision`
                    AND current_pursuit.`state` = 'ready_for_approval'
               )
             )
           )
           AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM json_each(p.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') manifest
               LEFT JOIN `generated_assets` a
                 ON a.`id` = json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.id')
                AND a.`user_id` = p.`user_id`
                AND a.`pursuit_id` = p.`pursuit_id`
              WHERE a.`id` IS NULL
                 OR a.`type` IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.type')
                 OR a.`type` NOT IN ('resume','cover_letter')
                 OR a.`version` IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.version')
                 OR a.`content_sha256` IS NULL
                 OR length(trim(a.`content_sha256`)) = 0
                 OR a.`content_sha256` IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.contentSha256')
                 OR a.`filename` IS NULL
                 OR length(trim(a.`filename`)) = 0
                 OR a.`filename` IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.filename')
                 OR a.`page_count` IS NULL
                 OR a.`page_count` <= 0
                 OR a.`page_count` IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.pageCount')
                 OR a.`review_state` <> 'claim_safe'
                 OR json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.reviewState') IS NOT 'claim_safe'
                 OR NOT json_valid(a.`content_json`)
                 OR json_type(a.`content_json`, '$.fileSha256') IS NOT 'text'
                 OR length(trim(json_extract(a.`content_json`, '$.fileSha256'))) = 0
                 OR json_extract(a.`content_json`, '$.fileSha256') IS NOT json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.fileSha256')
                 OR a.`invalidated_at` IS NOT NULL
                 OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM `generated_assets` newer
                    WHERE newer.`user_id` = a.`user_id`
                      AND newer.`pursuit_id` = a.`pursuit_id`
                      AND newer.`type` = a.`type`
                      AND newer.`version` > a.`version`
                      AND newer.`invalidated_at` IS NULL
                 )
           )
      )
      OR (
        NEW.`action` = 'submit_application'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
            FROM `external_action_approvals` package_approval
           WHERE package_approval.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
             AND package_approval.`pursuit_package_id` = NEW.`pursuit_package_id`
             AND package_approval.`action` = 'approve_application_package'
             AND package_approval.`payload_sha256` = NEW.`payload_sha256`
             AND package_approval.`state` = 'approved'
        )
      )
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approval lifecycle, timestamps, package, source version, form answers, or outbound assets are invalid');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `external_action_approvals_asset_source_binding_insert`
BEFORE INSERT ON `external_action_approvals`
WHEN NEW.`action` = 'approve_application_package'
  AND NEW.`state` IN ('approved','completed')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM `pursuit_packages` package,
           json_each(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.assets') manifest
      JOIN `generated_assets` asset
        ON asset.`id` = json_extract(manifest.`value`, '$.id')
       AND asset.`user_id` = package.`user_id`
       AND asset.`pursuit_id` = package.`pursuit_id`
      JOIN `pursuits` current_pursuit
        ON current_pursuit.`id` = package.`pursuit_id`
       AND current_pursuit.`user_id` = package.`user_id`
     WHERE package.`id` = NEW.`pursuit_package_id`
       AND package.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
       AND CASE

		OR NEW.`tax_amount_minor` IS NOT OLD.`tax_amount_minor`

		OR NEW.`refund_amount_minor` IS NOT OLD.`refund_amount_minor`
		OR NEW.`credit_amount_minor` IS NOT OLD.`credit_amount_minor`
		OR NEW.`chargeback_amount_minor` IS NOT OLD.`chargeback_amount_minor`
		OR NEW.`service_starts_at` IS NOT OLD.`service_starts_at`
		OR NEW.`service_ends_at` IS NOT OLD.`service_ends_at`
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'scheduled order economics are immutable; record an adjustment') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM `cost_events`
		WHERE `order_id` = OLD.`id` AND `category` = 'processor'
	) AND NEW.`processor_fee_micros` <> (
		SELECT `amount_micros` FROM `cost_events`
		WHERE `order_id` = OLD.`id` AND `category` = 'processor'
		ORDER BY `created_at` DESC LIMIT 1
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'processor fee must reconcile to its cost event') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT `stream` FROM `offer_versions` WHERE `id` = NEW.`offer_version_id`) NOT IN ('software', 'human_service')
		THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'affiliate revenue belongs in affiliate_events') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`cohort_membership_id` IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM `cohort_memberships`
		WHERE `id` = NEW.`cohort_membership_id`
			AND `user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
			AND `offer_version_id` = NEW.`offer_version_id`
	) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'order cohort offer mismatch') END;
	SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.`renewal_state` NOT IN ('none', 'opted_in', 'automatic', 'cancelled')
		OR NEW.`settlement_state` NOT IN ('pending', 'authorized', 'paid', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded', 'disputed', 'failed')

		OR NEW.`cash_collected_minor` > (NEW.`gross_amount_minor` - NEW.`discount_amount_minor` + NEW.`tax_amount_minor`)

END;

name: pursuit_packages_sync_pursuit_after_invalidation
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `pursuit_packages_sync_pursuit_after_invalidation`
AFTER UPDATE OF `readiness_state`,`blockers_json` ON `pursuit_packages`
WHEN (NEW.`readiness_state` <> 'ready_for_review' OR NEW.`blockers_json` <> '[]')
  AND NEW.`version` = (
    SELECT max(current_package.`version`)
      FROM `pursuit_packages` current_package
     WHERE current_package.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
       AND current_package.`pursuit_id` = NEW.`pursuit_id`
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM `pursuit_packages` replacement
     WHERE replacement.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
       AND replacement.`pursuit_id` = NEW.`pursuit_id`
       AND replacement.`version` > NEW.`version`
       AND replacement.`readiness_state` <> 'superseded'
  )
  AND (
    OLD.`readiness_state` = 'ready_for_review'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `pursuits` pursuit
       WHERE pursuit.`id` = NEW.`pursuit_id`
         AND pursuit.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
         AND (
           pursuit.`state` IN ('ready_for_approval','applying')
           OR pursuit.`external_approval_state` IN ('requested','approved')
         )
    )
  )
BEGIN
  UPDATE `pursuits`
     SET `state` = CASE
           WHEN `state` IN ('applied','interviewing','offered','accepted','closed') THEN `state`
           ELSE 'preparing'
         END,
         `revision` = `revision` + 1,
         `external_approval_state` = CASE
           WHEN `external_approval_state` = 'completed' THEN 'completed'
           ELSE 'revoked'
         END,
         `next_action` = CASE
           WHEN `state` IN ('applied','interviewing','offered','accepted','closed') THEN `next_action`
           ELSE 'The current application package changed and is no longer authorized. Review the current analysis, source, answers, and exact files before rebuilding it.'
         END,
         `updated_at` = unixepoch() * 1000
   WHERE `id` = NEW.`pursuit_id`
     AND `user_id` = NEW.`user_id`;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `external_action_approvals_source_recheck_insert`
BEFORE INSERT ON `external_action_approvals`
WHEN NEW.`action` = 'approve_application_package'
  AND NEW.`state` IN ('approved','completed')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM `pursuit_packages` package
      JOIN `job_posting_versions` version
        ON version.`id` = package.`job_posting_version_id`
      JOIN `audit_events` audit
        ON audit.`id` = json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.auditEventId')
       AND audit.`user_id` = package.`user_id`
       AND audit.`entity_type` = 'job_posting'
       AND audit.`entity_id` = version.`job_posting_id`
       AND audit.`event_type` IN ('greenhouse_job_ingested','lever_job_ingested','ashby_job_ingested')
     WHERE package.`id` = NEW.`pursuit_package_id`
       AND package.`user_id` = NEW.`user_id`
       AND json_valid(package.`asset_manifest_json`)
       AND json_valid(audit.`metadata_json`)
       AND json_extract(audit.`metadata_json`, '$.descriptionChecksum') IS version.`description_checksum`
       AND json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.descriptionChecksum') IS version.`description_checksum`
       AND json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.verifiedAt') IS audit.`created_at`
       AND json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.postingLastCheckedAt') IS audit.`created_at`
       AND json_type(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.postingLastCheckedAt') = 'integer'
       AND json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.postingLastCheckedAt') >= (unixepoch() * 1000 - 86400000)
       AND json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.postingLastCheckedAt') <= (unixepoch() * 1000 + 300000)
       AND abs(json_extract(package.`asset_manifest_json`, '$.sourceRecheck.postingLastCheckedAt') - audit.`created_at`) <= 300000
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'approval source recheck receipt is missing or older than 24 hours');
END;

   WHERE `pursuit_id` IN (
           SELECT pursuit.`id` FROM `pursuits` pursuit
            WHERE pursuit.`job_posting_id` = NEW.`id`

     AND `readiness_state` <> 'superseded';
  UPDATE `job_analyses`
     SET `validation_state` = 'invalidated',

   WHERE `job_posting_id` = NEW.`id`
     AND `validation_state` <> 'invalidated';
  UPDATE `pursuits`

         `state` = CASE
           WHEN `state` IN ('applied','interviewing','offered','accepted','closed') THEN `state`
           ELSE 'researching'

           ELSE 'The employer source returned to previously observed content after an intervening change. Recheck and reassess the current canonical version before rebuilding any application package.'

         `updated_at` = unixepoch() * 1000
